scripts:
set properties on /content/dam/ai-practical-assessment/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/ai-practical-assessment
  set jcr:title{String} to "AI Capability Project"
end

set properties on /content/ai-practical-assessment/support-tickets
  set sling:resourceType{String} to ai-practical-assessment/components/tickets-root
end

set ACL on /content/ai-practical-assessment/support-tickets
  allow jcr:read, jcr:write, jcr:nodeTypeManagement, rep:write for ticket-service
end

set ACL on /home/users
  allow jcr:read for ticket-service
end

set ACL on /home/groups
  allow jcr:read for ticket-service
end
